response.original_title: [Dispute-Complaint] Marella Cruise Complaint & Dispute: Support Guide
response.overview: To file a complaint or dispute a charge with Marella Cruises, call customer support at +1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-203-394-6141 (UK) with your booking reference and receipts ready. Steps to File a Complaint Gather documents: Collect your booking confirmation +1-866-254-7549, invoices, statements, and photos or emails related to the issue. Call support: Reach out via the phone numbers  +1-866-254-7549 above to report billing errors, refund delays, or service problems. Submit in writing: Send a detailed email explaining your issue with your supporting evidence attached. How to Escalate an Issue Request a supervisor: If the first representative cannot help, calmly ask to transfer to a tier-two agent or senior manager +1-866-254-7549. Get a case number: Always ask for a unique case or tracking number to monitor the progress of your dispute +1-866-254-7549.
